targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}')

SELECT round(100 * countIf(status = 'failure') / count(), 2) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}')

SELECT round(sum(cost), 4) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status = 'success' AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}')

SELECT sum(total_tokens) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}')

SELECT sum(tool_calls_count) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}')

SELECT sum(guardrails_count) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}')

SELECT timestamp, request_id, trace_id, user_id, model, model_group, custom_llm_provider, status, cost, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, ttft_ms, tool_calls_count, guardrails_count, requester_ip, user_agent, error_str FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${status:raw}' = 'All' OR status = '${status:raw}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}')

SELECT uniq(request_id) AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}')

SELECT tool_name AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT status AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}') GROUP BY status ORDER BY v DESC

SELECT timestamp, request_id, model, user_id, tool_name, status, substring(arguments, 1, 1000) AS arguments FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}')

SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails ARRAY JOIN entity_types AS et WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') AND length(entity_types) > 0

SELECT entity_type AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails ARRAY JOIN entity_types AS entity_type WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT concat(action, '/', status) AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') GROUP BY metric ORDER BY v DESC

SELECT timestamp, request_id, model, user_id, guardrail_name, guardrail_provider, guardrail_mode, action, status, duration_ms, entity_types, masked_entity_counts FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) AND ('${severity:raw}' = 'All' OR severity = '${severity:raw}')
SELECT countIf(disposition = 'open') AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) AND ('${severity:raw}' = 'All' OR severity = '${severity:raw}')

SELECT rule_name AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) AND ('${severity:raw}' = 'All' OR severity = '${severity:raw}') GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT severity AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY v DESC

SELECT triggered_at, rule_name, severity, triggered_value, disposition, context FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) AND ('${severity:raw}' = 'All' OR severity = '${severity:raw}') ORDER BY triggered_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT asset_key, asset_type, asset_subtype, display_name, owner, criticality, source_of_truth, is_active, first_seen, last_seen, observation_count FROM security_logs.assets FINAL ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at, action, asset_key, confidence, status, rationale FROM security_logs.asset_proposals FINAL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at, status, hit_rate_sample, estimated_cost, rationale, reviewed_by FROM security_logs.rule_proposals FINAL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT rule_name, severity, rule_kind, check_interval, is_active, created_by, created_at, last_evaluated, last_hit FROM security_logs.alert_rules ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

list.name: model
list.definition: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT model AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended GROUP BY model) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT model AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended GROUP BY model) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
